what: one number from the articles, counted up; with an icon, a count of 2-30 things is drawn as that many
use_when: one number carries the story: a count, a sum, a price the articles state
avoid_when: the number is a percent of a whole (share), a before and after (change) or one of several (bars)
rules: a "stat" may take an "icon": a whole count of 2-30 things is then drawn as that many icons;
a "stat" may take a "style": count (it counts up, the default), wheel (an odometer rolls to it) or flap (a split-flap board; never for politics or crime);
